_comment: EverQuest Legends pet naming reference for Berryworks. Observed in Jungleberry logs and fixtures; class type lists from eqlwiki.com/Pet_Guide.

log_patterns.notes: Primary EQL log form for other players' and NPC pets. Not possessive (no 's). Evidence: 'Hoptor Thaggelum pet', 'Miragul pet', 'a shadowknight pet', 'Prince Bragnar pet'.

log_patterns.pattern: Your pet's {Spell} spell has worn off.
log_patterns.notes: Wear-off line for buffs/debuffs on YOUR pet. Land messages still use the pet's display name as the target (see my_pet_name).

Your own pet often has a unique display name in land/combat lines (e.g. Gastik looks tranquil / Gastik says 'Sorry, Master...'). Set AppConfig.my_pet_name to that exact string so timers on your pet are kept when filtering.

suffix_rules.notes: Matches OwnerName pet / NPC pet suffix used throughout EQL combat and land lines.

classes.notes: Classic elemental display names; EQL often still shows Owner pet for other mages. Kept for detection if type names appear as targets.
Undead pet line; other necro pets commonly appear as '{Owner} pet' in EQL logs (e.g. Hoptor Thaggelum pet).
SK pets share undead models; logs also use '{Owner} pet' (Miragul pet, Prince Bragnar pet, Dragoon Zytl pet).
Warder summon spell names from Pet Guide. In combat logs, other BST pets usually still appear as '{Owner} pet'.
Animation summon line. Other enchanter pets in the wild typically log as '{Owner} pet'.
Shaman spirit pet line (wiki: Spirit Guardians). Prefer '{Owner} pet' detection for other players.
